note: The serving sidecar behind the apiN nginx that search.paxeer.network pins. tools/bringup/search-front.sh config renders this file: it replaces every "${NAME}" string with the value of the environment variable NAME, refuses an unset or empty one, and drops this note. X_WEBSEARCH_SEED_URL is the crawl seed URL. X_WEBSEARCH_<SID|PAX|USDC|USDL>_ASSET_ID is the asset's 32-byte id in hex and X_WEBSEARCH_<SID|PAX|USDC|USDL>_PRICE its price in that asset's base units for one request at 0.001 USD (tools/bringup/xweb-config.sh prices prints both). X_WEBSEARCH_GATEWAY_ENDPOINT is the gateway's /rpc URL, X_WEBSEARCH_SEQUENCER_ID and X_WEBSEARCH_SEQUENCER_PUBLIC_KEY the kernel sequencer's id and Ed25519 public key in hex. X_WEBSEARCH_EVM_ENDPOINT is the node's JSON-RPC URL on chain 125. Keys never go in this file; they are read from the files X_WEBSEARCH_ATTESTOR_KEY_FILE, X_WEBSEARCH_SUBMITTER_KEY_FILE and X_WEBSEARCH_RECEIVER_KEY_FILE name.
